fundamental_measure_definitions.yoy_growth_pct: 100 * (reported current fiscal quarter value / reported same fiscal quarter a year earlier - 1)
fundamental_measure_definitions.revenue_accel_pp: latest revenue YoY percentage minus previous reported quarter's revenue YoY percentage (percentage points)
fundamental_measure_definitions.eps_accel_pp: latest diluted EPS YoY percentage minus previous reported quarter's EPS YoY percentage (percentage points)
fundamental_measure_definitions.rising_absolute_3q: q0 > q1 > q2 among last 3 released quarters (not equivalent to accelerating growth)
fundamental_measure_definitions.growth_accelerating_3q: g_yoy_q0 > g_yoy_q1 > g_yoy_q2 (three sequential growth-rate points); zero acceleration at latest disqualifies
fundamental_measure_definitions.roic_ttm_pct: 100 * TTM NOPAT / average invested capital; denominator/corporate-action and accounting adjustment needed; null until verified
fundamental_measure_definitions.roe_ttm_pct: 100 * TTM net income / average common equity (needs verified two dated balance sheets)
fundamental_measure_definitions.roa_ttm_pct: 100 * TTM net income / average total assets (needs verified two dated balance sheets)
fundamental_measure_definitions.fcf_ttm: TTM CFO minus capital expenditures; not available in downloaded OHLCV

normalization_policy.formula: score = direction * tanh((raw - reference_median)/(2 * 1.4826 * reference_MAD)); score in [-1,+1]
normalization_policy.fit_population: Historical eligible public-US stock-event records matched by calendar era and industry where adequate; use only training-window observations as of the particular event. Reference cohort snapshots and revisions must be archived.
normalization_policy.direction_policy: No score without locked, prevalidated direction; higher raw prior runup may signal momentum OR priced-in headwind; do not force bearish polarity without independent training.
normalization_policy.no_available_calibration_action: null, never zero and never derive from outcomes or two AAPL examples
normalization_policy.composites: Hold null until nonoverlapping train/validation/test cohort and controls calibrate features and monotonicity; no hand-fixed weights and no profitability claims.

price_in_policy.pre_event_consensus: Snapshot strictly before earnings/public release when reporting an analyst surprise; must retain vintage, analyst count, fiscal period, EPS GAAP/non-GAAP comparability and currency/share split factors
price_in_policy.surprise_sales_pct: 100 * (actual_revenue - consensus_revenue)/consensus_revenue only if consensus>0 and as-of timing valid
price_in_policy.surprise_eps_pct: 100 * (actual_eps_same_basis - consensus_eps_same_basis)/max(abs(consensus_eps),frozen_reference_eps_denominator_floor); mark as missing for noncomparability or a nonpositive denominating condition if no floor
price_in_policy.prices: Any pre-event excess-return window must end on/before event cutoff. Earnings-reaction window must end before the breakout event; no post-breakout reactions as inputs
price_in_policy.definition_note: Price-in cannot be measured as an observed known percent. Composite is a conditional proxy subject to market model and evidence coverage, not a fact or guarantee.
price_in_policy.common_source_deficit: No verified 2005/2006 point-in-time analyst-consensus snapshots or market/industry controls in R001 AAPL. Preserve all dependent fields as null.
price_in_policy.news_vintage_exception: Contemporary pre-announcement public article can support provisional raw revenue consensus by publication date even if original proprietary vendor vintage and UTC timestamp cannot be independently obtained. Never invent precise snapshot UTC. Preserve alternate quotes and provider conflicts; no model training certification.
price_in_policy.raw_price_reaction: Report-day-to-next-session-close percentage from owner-held FMP CSV is descriptive, not benchmark-adjusted nor causal, especially 2005-10-12 video iPod introduction.
